title: Retention Risk Rubric
description: A rubric scored so HIGH means MORE risk, which inverts the usual reading and is the single most common way a retention score gets misused. Absent evidence defaults to NeutralMidpoint rather than Zero, because a member we know nothing about is unknown risk, not zero risk — scoring them safe is how the quiet ones get missed.

weights.description: Risk contributors. Bind disengagement to a recency measure, tenure to a tenure column, and payment_friction to a billing signal where one exists.
